tagline: Leading technology company with strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities delivering purposeful solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBITA margin of 13.8% reflecting operational discipline and sustained profitability during major 2025 strategic transformation, notably the divestiture of Vivicta and repositioning toward mission-critical software and technology consulting.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company over the year
kpis.description: Revenue of 1.852 billion euros reflects Tieto's new direction following the divestiture of Tietoevry Tech Services (Vivicta) in September 2025.
kpis.signal: Consolidated revenue in 2025 after infrastructure business divestiture

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin (EBITA)
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit (EBITA) divided by revenue
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITA margin stands at 13.8%, indicating operational discipline maintained during the strategic transition toward mission-critical software and technology consulting.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITA margin stable despite transformation

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company
kpis.description: Tieto has 14,000 professionals, primarily dedicated to technology consulting and mission-critical software.
kpis.signal: Key headcount metric for technology services delivery

kpis.name: Dividend Yield
kpis.explanation: Dividend per share divided by stock price
kpis.description: Dividend yield stands at 4.8%, reflecting a sustained distribution policy despite the transformation.
kpis.signal: Attractive yield for European equity investors

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Indicator tracked annually, historical values over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 1.85 billion euros in latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 2.25 billion euros in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.71 billion euros in latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.13 billion euros in latest year

kpis.name: GHG Emission Reduction (Scope 1 and 2)
kpis.explanation: Decline in greenhouse gas emissions since 2020
kpis.description: 88% reduction in GHG emissions in own operations since 2020, demonstrating strong commitment to ecological transition.

kpis.name: Managers Trained on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
kpis.explanation: Percentage of managers trained on diversity, equity and inclusion
kpis.description: 87% of managers have completed diversity, equity and inclusion training, strengthening inclusive culture across the company.
kpis.signal: High level of managerial engagement on social issues

kpis.name: Employee Confidence in Reporting Unethical Behavior
kpis.explanation: Level of employee confidence in speaking up about unethical behavior
kpis.description: Employees rate their confidence to report unethical behavior at 8.5/10, indicating strong transparency levels and psychological safety internally.
kpis.signal: Strong ethical culture supported by employee voice

risks.title: Heightened competition in software solutions
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned indirectly in CEO strategic review, with measured language but upward trend due to post-divestiture strategy overhaul. Competition category is central for Tieto as an expanding software player.

risks.title: Dependence on international strategic partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Risk emerging from partnership announcements (e.g. Siemens, NTT DATA), with cautious language. Trend is stable, but dependence on co-developments raises technology control and operational synchronization concerns.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection
risks.score_rationale: Risk strongly emphasized in Sustainability Pledge with strict objectives (zero major violations). Language is intense, trend is stable, and category is critical for a mission-critical digital services company.

risks.title: Rising regulation on responsible AI
risks.score_rationale: Text explicitly cites impact of European AI Act and OECD principles. Language is preventive but intense, trend is upward, and AI compliance is strategic for software products.

risks.title: Integration of new international acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Risk illustrated by OpenSpring and Grupo Onetec acquisitions in Spain. Language is cautious, trend is emerging, and operational integration is critical for growth targets.

risks.title: Dependence on specialized technology talent
risks.score_rationale: CEO emphasizes 14,000 experts as core asset. Language is positive but reveals strong dependence. Trend is stable, and digital talent scarcity is a structural challenge.

risks.title: Strategic overhaul and direction clarity
risks.score_rationale: CEO mentions perceived lack of clarity among customers following multiple strategic shifts. Language is reflective, trend is improving, but reputational risk persists.

ai_positioning.summary: Tieto adopts an integrator posture on AI, launching cross-functional programs on AI capabilities and strengthening software offerings with intelligent features, without positioning AI as a distinct revenue segment.
evidence: Launch of cross-functional programs on AI capabilities
Executive team renewal with focus on innovation
Strategy centered on 'purposeful technology' solutions integrating AI
